title: XBuilderLAB/cheat-on-content
claim: Cheat on Content — a workflow that makes creators blind-predict each post's performance before publishing, then retro against actuals, building a personal ledger of what works.
why_good: Calibration loops are how forecasters and quants improve; nobody has productized them for content. 5.9k★ and 14 contributors say the pain (publish → guess → learn nothing) is widely felt.
value: A creator-analytics SaaS: prediction journal plus platform-metrics ingestion plus per-account pattern reports — solo creators first, then agencies running many accounts.
risk: The README's '0 to 1M followers in a month' claim is unverifiable marketing; as a prompt workflow it's clonable in a weekend, and platform-native analytics could absorb the idea.
